observations.body: The assembly blesses God, recounts Abraham, Egypt, Sinai, wilderness, conquest, judges, kings, prophets, exile, and present servitude, and makes a written covenant.

payload.tension: The people are back in the land yet still call themselves slaves under foreign kings.
